blocks.text: CEBU CITY — Quick-thinking store representatives and vigilant security personnel at Nustar Resort and Casino thwarted a high-value luxury fraud scheme on November 2, 2026, leading to the arrest of a foreign national. The suspect, identified as 36-year-old Chinese national Cao, was arrested following an alleged fraudulent shopping spree involving compromised credit card credentials linked to Apple Pay. According to a police report filed by Police Station 11 (PS11), the incident occurred at the Louis Vuitton boutique inside Nustar Resort and Casino in Barangay Mambaling.
